Starting student and general Aloe+Zoom partner

Four two-minute conversational rollouts. The student is on the left channel; the frozen audio-duplex partner is on the right. Headphones help separate them.

Starting checkpoints, before the new training run: pose-duplex student export-211 and general ppm-aloe-zoom-cotrain partner export-253. The partner is the general model that initialized the Rosie fine-tune.

The student uses natural temperature-one sampling for text, audio and pose. The partner uses the settings from your website link. They hear each other’s generated audio at the restored raw level. Each recording starts with its recorded 3–5-second prefill; pose was generated but is not rendered here.

Partner sampling settings

Factorized text; temperature 1; relative min-p 0.1; frequency penalty 0.3 over 50 word pieces; no text grammar. Adaptive PAD: −0.1 after 3 seconds silent, otherwise 0. Audio temperature 1, cb0 top-k 50, light top-k 100. Audio CFG, repetition penalties and n-gram penalty off. No extra loudness normalization in playback.
